concerns.text: SC-001 requires extraction accuracy ≥ 95% (proportion of correctly captured fields) on the ≥100-summary annotated set, but T007's verification only asserts 'precision ≥ 85%, recall ≥ 75%, F1 ≥ 0.80' (FR-031b/SC-031b thresholds). The 95% SC-001 acceptance criterion is dropped from every task's verification — a silent narrowing of a spec success criterion. Either add the SC-001 field-accuracy check to T007's verification or record in the spec that SC-001 is superseded by SC-031b.

T004's verification checks schema validity, traceability of reconstructed_p, and SC-005 error rate, but never verifies the FR-004 flagging thresholds themselves (|Δp| > 0.05 absolute; inequality-bound rule; effect-size relative difference > 5% of larger magnitude). Since T001 relocates the flagging implementation 'without behavioral change', no task's verification step confirms the constitutional 0.05 absolute threshold (Constitution VI) is actually enforced in output. Add a check that a record with diff_abs_p = 0.06 is flagged inconsistent (spec US-1 scenario 2).

FR-026 requires 'contract tests must be executed against the inline schema definition in FR-002' (ABSummary). T004 validates audit records against audit_record.schema.yaml and T002 validates the synthetic dataset, but no task verifies that extracted ABSummary records conform to the FR-002 inline schema. Add ABSummary schema validation to T004's verification.
